description: Diagnostic module to analyze why temporal_stability_enrichment.py produces only 4 distinct scores. Tests compute_score() against varied metadata (first_seen, last_updated, last_assessed, age_days across a 0-730 day range, update_frequency). Reports score bucket distribution and identifies the flattening behavior. Per spec section 10: emit findings consumable by directive generator for enrichment improvements. Do NOT modify the existing enrichment.
